diagram_note: Calculated reference from results/tables and the formulas in src/gunnchos_rf. The link-budget and LNA lines are repository table text, not a measured over-the-air link.

rows.ethical_framing: fspl_db is 32.45 + 20*log10(d_km) + 20*log10(f_mhz). link_budget adds gains and subtracts losses from tx_dbm.
# Link budget FSPL 1km 2.4GHz = 100.1 dB Rx=-75.05422483423212 dBm
nf_to_noise_temp uses t0 default 290 and returns t0*(10**(nf_db/10)-1).
wilkinson_z returns z0 * 1.414 with z0 default 50.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS RF Front-End Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: Link budgets, matching, filters, LNAs — complements gunnchos-hardware-industrial-design.

sections.title: Commands
sections.body: make install && make test && make e2e

methods: Methods are the formulas in src/gunnchos_rf/link_budget.py and lna_noise_gain.py. The numbers on this page are copied from results/tables/link_budget.md and results/tables/lna_tradeoff.md. They are calculated reference lines, not a measured link.
